strategies.title: Strategy Control
strategies.disposition: Phase 1 remains preserved with final result APPROVED_SPACE_EXHAUSTED / RESEARCH_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED. Phase 2 routes 1 and 2 remain terminally implementation-inconclusive with no economic result, and route 3 remains terminally methodology-inconclusive with no economic result. Route 4's explicitly authorized fourth live read-only Sol/xhigh no-data direction review returned substantive REVISION_REQUIRED: 16 of 19 checks passed and checks 1, 8, and 9 failed, producing two major requested revisions. The reviewed output schema still closes draft_sha256 to superseded hash 144d795799304945e115b9006d54fc6490b31dc00c3c0e485094980bbab21c0e rather than revised hash 48ff7c37eaec1babf5a463f90900b6f188e99c8dd38056c351509b461c61d86e. The current evidence contract also cannot represent no-response DNS, TLS, reset, or timeout attempts in its response-only raw index or reconstruct immutable logical terminal outcomes from raw evidence alone. The revised draft remains unfrozen, acquisition remains prohibited, and Route 4 is nonterminal as DIRECTION_REVISION_REQUIRES_HUMAN_AUTHORIZATION. The service-only retry is closed because the review was substantive, and no fifth review or automatic revision is authorized. This is not DATA_NO_GO, HISTORICAL_NO_GO, a strategy result, or evidence of profitability or unprofitability. No route-4 network data request, archive object discovery or download, market-data access, strategy return, model training, backtest, implementation repair, acquisition attempt, or holdout access occurred. Controller tests and contract checks are not evidence of trading profitability. Every Phase 2 final holdout remains closed and unread, no candidate is promoted, capital remains zero, GPU permission remains zero, and Vertcoin mining is unchanged.
